primaryWitnesses.text: Then Solomon began to build the LORD’s house at Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the LORD appeared to David his father, which he prepared in the place that David had appointed, on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: He set seventy thousand of them to bear burdens, eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred overseers to assign the people their work.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: He began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.
